notes: Governing document: UM System CRR 340.070 Faculty Leave (amended 2-9-17; the document's version note says the next amendment is 4-12-18, after the reference date 2018-03-12), a system-wide faculty leave policy covering UMKC tenured and tenure-track faculty; missing is false. CRR 340.010 (Bd. Min. 2-9-17) defers to 340.070.B.2 for faculty. No UMKC campus-level parental policy was saved; the UMKC Provost page is a procedure and summary page pointing to CRR 340.070.

Dates: the Provost page is undated and its copy is from 2017-06-16, just before the 2017-18 academic year; it is used only for procedure (90-day request notice, request for tenure-clock extension) and agrees with the 2-9-17 CRR text (it cites CRR 340.070 B.2.f and E). The sick-leave rule's copy is from 2016-08-24 (last amendment 9-13-13); its components (c7, c8, staff only) are flagged version_uncertain.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1) with paid family and medical leave up to 12 weeks within it (c2), both inside the semester whose remainder is released from classroom teaching (c3, negotiated pay; c2 within c3 under R3b). Pregnancy incapacity is an FMLA reason inside the same 12 weeks; no separate childbirth period exists.

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1) with paid family and medical leave up to 12 weeks within it (c2) → classroom release for the balance of the semester containing the leave (c3, negotiated). Same as the birth parent.

Paid family and medical leave (c2) is for any FMLA event, not only a birth; it is listed under C1 (it pays leave for a birth or adoption) and C10 (pay for an FMLA-qualifying absence). Pay level is not stated beyond 'will be paid'. It is paid only for the portion of leave within normally scheduled work duties; faculty covered by another approved University vacation/sick leave policy follow that policy instead (path not coded: CRR 340.030 sick-leave accrual covers ASS staff and certain non-regular academics, not regular tenure-stream faculty).

The return obligation 'All faculty members who accept a paid leave must state their intention to return to the University for the same amount of time they plan to be gone' appears in CRR 340.070 under Professional Leave and on the Provost page as a general statement; it is not applied to c2, since the CRR places it with professional leaves.

Not components: research, development and sabbatical leaves (CRR 340.070 A) exist for scholarly or professional purposes and are not leaves a parent would take for a birth; military leave; covered-service-member leave.

Cross-references not saved: CRR 340.060 Personal Days and 340.020 Leave of Absence (named only in page navigation); HR Policy Manual (military leave); Request for Leave of Absence Form UM108; CRR 340.090 Development Leave for Administrative, Service and Support Employees; University benefit programs (optional long-term disability); CRR 310.020 Section B.2.a; Sections 310.060, 310.070, 370.010, 600.040 (dismissal, notice, grievance, equity procedures; not leave).
